findings.finding: The lack of Rewrite/Have/Transitivity constructors does not establish impossibility of connected certificate transport. Existing Induction, Congruence and Apply expose a plausible small axiom-free route; it must be tried before declaring an actual DSL blocker.

sourceAnalysis.facts: Congruence is a nullary proof form emitting only congr 1. Apply emits exact priorTheorem arguments and validates a prior document theorem, argument arity/types. There is no sequence/continuation on Congruence, so congr then Apply cannot simply be encoded as one proof. Induction emits branches with an induction hypothesis available to a Congruence branch.

Existing product proof source already uses Induction with Congruence on a lifted goal and a later exact Apply to a definitionally equal goal. This review inspected its source only; it is an encoding precedent, not fresh acceptance evidence for the Object probe.
The exact retained small Result Simplify probe was rejected for observed propext. This is not a proof that every possible simp proof introduces propext, nor that Congruence does.

transportProbe.purpose: Consume that exact accepted leaf equation in a nonidentity actual Object parent-result context using supported pure LexLean proof forms.
transportProbe.types: T = Result ObjRecord ObjError; a,b : ObjNodeId are ordinary theorem parameters, not supplied computed hashes.
transportProbe.context: C a b r := match r with | Result.error e => Result.error e | Result.ok leaf => R4.ObjectStore.ObjMakeParent 1 a b leaf.id
transportProbe.whyNonidentity: C invokes the actual ObjMakeParent operation with two parameter children and the certificate-derived third child. It does not return r, replace the computation with a constant, or assume a parent digest.
transportProbe.iterator: I a b 0 r := r; I a b (n+1) r := C a b (I a b n r). Author only this structurally recursive proof-local semantic definition; do not alter production Object definitions.
transportProbe.liftedStatement: For parameters a,b,n: I a b n (ObjMakeLeaf [0]) = I a b n (Result.ok expectedRecord).
transportProbe.proofAST: Induction on n. zero branch: Apply the accepted objTrace257Record10 certificate, with no arguments. succ branch binders n,ih: Congruence. No Simplify, raw Lean injection or new axiom.
transportProbe.expectedGeneratedProof:
induction n with
| zero => exact LeafCertificate.objTrace257Record10
| succ n ih => congr 1
transportProbe.consumerStatement: (match ObjMakeLeaf [0] with | Result.error e => Result.error e | Result.ok leaf => ObjMakeParent 1 a b leaf.id) = ObjMakeParent 1 a b expectedRecord.id
transportProbe.consumerProof: Apply lifted theorem with semantic arguments a,b,1. By unfolding I at1, C and the Result.ok match on the right, this target is definitionally equal to that instance. No propositional rewrite is required merely to state this consumer.
